# Elise Javetski

> Elise Javetski is a prenatal and postpartum strength coach in Jersey City, NJ. She offers 1-on-1 coaching (in person or online), weekly group strength classes for moms, core and pelvic floor work, and assisted stretching. She's a NASM Certified Personal Trainer, a Girls Gone Strong certified pre- and postnatal coach, and certified in Performance Stretch System Levels 1 and 2. She's also a mom and trained through her own pregnancy.

## Services

- 1-on-1 prenatal and postpartum coaching: in person in Jersey City or online. Strength training, core, breathing and pelvic floor work, assisted stretching, weekly check-ins and a plan to follow at home.
- Group strength classes in Jersey City for anyone expecting or postpartum. Elise adapts every move for each person.
  - Mondays at 12pm: Alpha Fit Club, 10 Provost St, Downtown Jersey City
  - Tuesdays and Thursdays at 12pm: /impact/ Group Fitness, 63 Hutton St, Jersey City Heights
- Assisted stretching (Performance Stretch System), plus assisted stretch workshops in New York City.

## Pricing (1-on-1 coaching)

- Single session: $140
- 5-session pack: $650, expires 3 months after purchase
- 10-session pack: $1,250, expires 6 months after purchase

## Common questions

- When can I start training after having a baby? Once your provider clears you, often around six weeks postpartum. Elise starts with breathing and core reconnection, then builds strength step by step.
- Can I work with Elise if I have diastasis recti or pelvic floor concerns? Yes. Her programming is diastasis-aware and focused on core and pelvic floor function, and she's happy to coordinate with your pelvic floor physical therapist.
- Areas served: Jersey City (including the Heights and Downtown), Hoboken, and anywhere online.
